temperature, different time: thickness decides how long the heat takes to reach the middle. Size Air fryer Pack says Mini pizza, 5" (13 cm) 380°F / 195°C · 6 min 400°F / 205°C · 8 min Personal pizza, 7–8" (18–20 cm) 380°F / 195°C · 9 min 400°F / 205°C · 12 min 10–12" (25–30 cm): oven-style or 8 qt+ only 380°F / 195°C · 12 min 400°F / 205°C · 16 min Why the top is done before the base In an air fryer the heat comes from above, and the fan blows it straight across the top of the pizza. Cheese and toppings sit closest to the element and start browning almost at once, while the base underneath is still frozen dough sitting on the basket. Run it hot and you get scorched pepperoni on a pale, bendy crust. A slightly lower setting than you might expect lets heat soak down through the pizza so the base crisps by the time the cheese has melted and blistered. Size is the other half: a pizza that is jammed against the walls blocks the airflow, so the base steams instead of crisping. It has to lie flat with a gap around the edge. Worked example: a personal pizza A personal pizza box says 400°F for 12 minutes, straight on the oven rack. In a basket air fryer that becomes 380°F for 9 minutes. Preheat 4 minutes so the base starts on a hot surface, lay the pizza flat, and leave it alone; there is nothing to turn. Check underneath at the low end of the time by lifting an edge with a spatula. A mini pizza is ready in about 6 minutes; a large one in an oven-style air fryer needs about 12. How to tell it is done Lift the edge: the underside should be golden and firm, and the slice should hold straight out rather than flop. The cheese should be fully melted and bubbling in the centre, not just at the edges. If the top is ready but the base is still soft, lay a piece of foil loosely over the top and give it two more minutes. Will it fit? Measure your basket before you buy. A 5 qt round basket is only about 8 to 8½ inches (20–22 cm) across inside, so a personal pizza of 7 to 8 inches fits with a little room. A 10 or 12 inch pizza does not: it needs an oven-style air fryer or a basket of around 8 qt and up. Remove all packaging, including the cardboard disc. About 9 minutes at 380°F for a 7–8 inch personal pizza. A 5 inch mini takes about 6 minutes. What size frozen pizza fits in an air fryer? In a 5 qt basket, about 8 inches at most, because the inside is only around 8 to 8½ inches across. A 10–12 inch pizza needs an oven-style unit or an 8 qt or larger basket; otherwise cut it in half and cook it in two goes. Do I need to preheat for frozen pizza? Yes, for 4 minutes. A hot basket gives the frozen base a head start so it crisps before the cheese overcooks. Why is my pizza base soggy? The pizza is too big for the basket and the air cannot get around it, or the cardboard was left underneath. It needs to lie flat with space at the edges. Should I flip a frozen pizza? No. Toppings slide off. Leave it flat and check the underside at the low end of the time.
